snippet.title: Luctus - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567380/Luctus/

Luctus is an immersive story-based action-adventure game brought to life with a Pixel Art aesthetic. An in-depth experience filled with memorable characters and a rich universe awaits you. The game blends the dramatic story of our protagonist Nora with action-packed scenes and epic boss battles.

Music Composer: Eran Yakar

Discord: https://discord.gg/9ZyJ3mV7Hz
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mriyagames/
